operator_class.name: CONSTRAINT_ONLY_WITNESS_FILTER
operator_class.definition: Start from a CNF sibling merge Q and form M=Q union K, where K is any additional CNF filter, possibly using arbitrary fresh auxiliary variables, while every clause of Q is retained unchanged.
operator_class.intent: K may try to retain only a convenient polynomially liftable subset of Q's models.

theorem.statement: For every pair of CNFs Q,K, delta*(Q union K) >= delta*(Q).
proof: By definition delta*(Q) is attained by some clause subset W subseteq Q.
Since Q subseteq Q union K, the same W is a valid clause subset of Q union K.
W contains no clause of K, so any fresh variables occurring only in K are absent from Var(W).
Therefore deficiency(W) is unchanged inside the enlarged formula, and delta*(Q union K) is at least deficiency(W)=delta*(Q).
theorem.fresh_variable_robustness: Adding arbitrarily many fresh variables inside K does not help because the inherited maxdef witness can ignore all K clauses and hence all K-only variables.

R44BD_effect.if_base_rank_is_k: A constraint-only filter cannot turn rank k into rank <=k-1.
R44BD_effect.R44BM_application: Starting from the compact sibling split merge of rank exactly k, conjoining any witness filter while retaining its clauses leaves maximum deficiency at least k.
R44BD_effect.R44BN_application: Starting from any projection-faithful auxiliary-free representation of the fixed R44AS projection with rank >=3, conjoining constraints cannot repair the rank lower bound.
R44BD_effect.architectural_conclusion: A successful SAT-only/witness-transforming sibling compression must perform an exact destructive operation: safe restriction, quotient/substitution, clause replacement/deletion with proof, or a different representation. Mere conjunction is insufficient.

not_blocked: filters followed by independently proved exact deletion or substitution that removes the inherited maxdef witness
safe assignments or safe quotient relations
operators that replace rather than retain the old clause set

next_admissible_math.question: Can sibling structure yield a polynomially checkable certificate permitting an exact assignment, quotient, or replacement that deletes enough inherited clause debt to force delta* descent while preserving polynomial witness/certificate replay?
next_admissible_math.anti_drift: A new filter that only conjoins clauses without deleting/replacing inherited debt is already blocked by R44BO.
